criteria.requirement: Implement cattrs.strategies.base64.configure_base64(converter, *, urlsafe=False) with paired bytes hooks on the supplied real converter. Support nested existing JSON converters, empty/all-byte payloads and explicitly selected URL-safe alphabet. Strictly reject bad padding, non-ASCII and invalid characters, never guess formats or affect unconfigured base85 defaults. Later user hooks remain higher priority and non-string structure input fails clearly.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
